text:
I would like to have several spare smiles

and a vast repertory of ways to express myself.

Either with words, or with manners,

to seek the skillful gesture that might shield me...


And, as with the gesture, to seek in lying

different disguises, to dress deception well;

and to be able, without conscience, to go around giving people,

with subtle maneuvering, the caress of harm.


I would like to-and I cannot!-be as others are,

those who people the world and call themselves human:

always the kiss on the lip, hiding the facts,

and in the end... washing their hands so calmly.

translation.title: I Would Like to Have Several Spare Smiles
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the speaker's bitter wish for social masks she cannot wear.
